{"items":[{"ref":"E03","coverage_id":"coverage-f49929bfbcc31137","coverage_title":"选择页：更换为下午二层服务台后的状态反馈","task_id":"TASK01","applicability":"applicable","reason":"REQ01要求可更换选择；当前上午选中、下午未选中。需比较切换前后状态，静态控件不能证明切换成功。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-e57f71fbe2114b2598a77b2508683b5e","ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["选择下午选项的动作记录及后状态","进入核对页的动作记录及所显示的时段、服务台"],"object_refs":["page-ebec49243e0ab8ae","选择页的两个时段选项及“核对信息”按钮"],"object_ids":["obj-d23b643004bbc7089e7d","obj-9a05df3aa32e6dbc9354"],"constraint_refs":["REQ01"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E03","coverage_id":"coverage-00985e7c4fe62894","coverage_title":"BR02：提交动作与完成页登记信息对应","task_id":"TASK03","applicability":"applicable","reason":"REQ03明确提交后的显示要求；需将最终确认值与完成页逐项比较，目前仅有选择页。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["提交前最终确认的时段和服务台","提交动作记录、完成页画面及观察条件"],"object_refs":["BR02","待取得的核对页提交控件与完成页登记结果"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ03"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E04","coverage_id":"coverage-ed287ed6ebf0b7a9","coverage_title":"BR01：核对页返回选择后的选项保留","task_id":"TASK02","applicability":"applicable","reason":"REQ02明确要求返回时保留时段和服务台；需比较返回前后的下午选择，不能由初始截图推断保留情况。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["下午选中后进入核对页的状态","使用“返回选择”的动作及返回后选中状态","再次核对时显示的时段和服务台"],"object_refs":["BR01","待取得的“返回选择”控件与返回后的选择状态"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ02"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E04","coverage_id":"coverage-69570b8a3c19099f","coverage_title":"BR03：刷新与重新开始的复位路径","task_id":"TASK04","applicability":"applicable","reason":"REQ04明确两种复位入口均回到选择页；未规定复位后的默认选项，不额外要求恢复上午或清空选择。","source_ids":["src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e","src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644"],"evidence_needed":["刷新前后状态与动作记录","完成页“重新开始”前后状态与动作记录"],"object_refs":["BR03","刷新复位路径","待取得的完成页“重新开始”控件"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ04"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E05","coverage_id":"coverage-2fc659171b034ad4","coverage_title":"登记流程异常及恢复条件待明确","task_id":"TASK03","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"材料只描述正常登记和复位，未提供异常设计或异常观察；不能因未见错误认定不适用，也不擅自补设网络异常。","source_ids":["src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe","src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644","ev-e57f71fbe2114b2598a77b2508683b5e"],"evidence_needed":["明确异常条件及预期恢复规则，或后续实际异常证据","若存在异常对象，取得安全恢复路径与动作结果"],"object_refs":["TASK03登记流程中的潜在异常分支，具体对象尚未取得"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E06","coverage_id":"coverage-f49929bfbcc31137","coverage_title":"选择页：核对信息操作的前置条件待明确","task_id":"TASK01","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"当前已有默认选择且核对按钮可用；材料未明确操作开放或拦截规则，不能把步骤顺序自行升级为前置条件。","source_ids":["src-7392c34aea88490ba597858b545ceebe","src-6a906de7fe0c40158f5877fd3b43d70e"],"evidence_ids":["ev-c609eb48befe403ebb2eeebeaf0a9644","ev-e57f71fbe2114b2598a77b2508683b5e"],"evidence_needed":["是否存在核对操作前置条件及其正式原文","若有条件，取得满足与不满足时的控件状态及安全操作结果"],"object_refs":["page-ebec49243e0ab8ae","核对信息"],"object_ids":["obj-9a05df3aa32e6dbc9354"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]}]}
